title: Maia S NDE 6206
content: During childbirth I was given an epidural and immediately afterwards I felt more comfortable but not pain free. I lay back on the bed and within seconds started to feel like I was going to be sick. I asked my husband for a receiver by which time every movement of people around me seemed to slow right down which confused me at the time as I didn't feel like I was in the same time zone. It felt like everyone else was in slow motion, at the same time even though I could sense people's panic everything started to become very quiet. I sensed that I was going to die but wasn't concerned. I felt a sense of completeness and that my unborn daughter was going to be fine with her dad without me and that I'd achieved what I was meant to do. As I shut my eyes, I was immediately above my own body and could see the whole of the labor room below me as if I was watching a scene of a play unfold. At that point, I was aware that there was no sense of pain or pleasure or even movement within my body, it was an unnaturally calm, still and complete weightlessness that I cannot liken to anything I've ever felt before or since that time. The feeling seemed to be a split second in time then the feeling of my own steady breathing came back and I opened my eyes to find myself back within my body. My mum was at the end of my bed crying asking me if I'd remembered what had happened. I answered that yes I knew I was close to death but I knew everything was going to be ok either way. She was so worried that she'd nearly lost me. After the experience I realized that instead of the split second that I thought had passed, it had actually been 45 minutes and felt extremely baffled as to what had just happened.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Epidural during childbirth; felt close to death afterward.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Time distortion: perceived only a split second, later learned ~45 minutes had passed; perceived others moving in slow motion and the room becoming very quiet.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Time slowed/quieted, then eyes shut and immediate OBE above body in labor room, then rapid return to body with awareness of breathing.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived a major time discrepancy: experienced it as a split second but later learned it had been 45 minutes.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was immediately above my own body and could see the whole of the labor room below me as if I was watching a scene of a play unfold.”
